title: What is cyanography?
description:
Hidden behind the trees in Tujunga is one of Los Angeles’ best-kept creative secrets—the McGroarty Arts Center! 

During its summer arts workshops, participants explored the mesmerizing world of cyanotype, one of the earliest forms of photography. Using a special chemical process, natural sunlight, and a little creativity, artists transformed everyday objects into striking blue-and-white prints. 

From trending crafts to timeless techniques, the McGroarty Arts Center makes arts education affordable and accessible while bringing people together through creativity and community.

Learn more about upcoming classes at McGroarty Arts Center https://www.mcgroartyartscenter.org/
